items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Mrs. "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1960-05-23
items.q: Gussie Miller's living too. Yeah, he sent us a nice letter.

ctx.x: We got a letter from Gussie Miller when Pocket died. Oh yeah, Gussie's living too.
Gussie Miller's living too. Yeah, he sent us a nice letter.
How much did they pay you for those funerals? Three dollars. Three dollars a man. Were colored bands playing funerals when you started playing?
